MappingPocPage                         injected services + editing contexts
          |                                                                               
          |-- injected services
          |   |-- DiagramService                 shared service; opaque contexts
          |   `-- CodeRepoService                contract injected; operations unwired
          |
          |-- drafts[documentId]: Draft           page metadata + mirrored state          
          |   |-- representationId?              absent until diagram is saved            
          |   |-- name / revisionId              saved catalog revision baseline
          |   |-- savedName / savedScene          dirty-state baseline                    
          |   |-- busy                                                                    
          |   |-- document / canvas              mirror controller state                  
          |   |-- history?: CanvasHistoryRecord  mirrored for persistence
          |   |-- viewport?: CanvasTransform     camera pan / zoom                        
          |   `-- focusBox? { id, serial }                                                
          |                                                                               
          |-- controllers[documentId]: MappingDocumentController                          
          |   |
          |   |-- diagrams: DiagramService       injected dependency
          |   |-- context: DiagramEditingContext opaque runtime handle
          |   |   `-- history owned behind DiagramService boundary
          |   |
          |   |-- getSnapshot(): ControllerSnapshot                                       
          |   |   |-- contextId                  editing-history identity
          |   |   |-- canvasRevisionId           current checkpoint identity
          |   |   |-- version                    command concurrency counter
          |   |   |-- canUndo / canRedo           from DiagramService.state(context)
          |   |   |                                                                       
          |   |   |-- document: MappingGridDocument   legacy materialized document
          |   |   |   |-- scene: LineGridScene                                            
          |   |   |   |   |-- root: GridBox      grid containment + layout                
          |   |   |   |   `-- contents[id]: Diagram                                       
          |   |   |   |       |-- id / revision                                           
          |   |   |   |       |-- content: DiagramContent                                 
          |   |   |   |       `-- sourceContext: DiagramSourceContext                     
          |   |   |   |           |-- binding?         per-diagram repository             
          |   |   |   |           |-- mappings[]                                          
          |   |   |   |           `-- evidence         selection nodes derived            
          |   |   |   |-- edges[]                   legacy revision-bearing anchors
          |   |   |   `-- sections[contentId][]                                           
          |   |   |                                                                       
          |   |   `-- canvas: MappingCanvasState                                          
          |   |       |-- display: DisplayState FLOATING OBJECTS ONLY                     
          |   |       |   |-- rootIds[]                                                   
          |   |       |   `-- nodes[id]: FloatingBox                                      
          |   |       `-- controls: MappingControls                                       
          |   |           |-- activeBoxId                                                 
          |   |           |-- selectionRect / selectedNodeIds[]                           
          |   |           |-- retainedSelectionId / activeThreadId                        
          |   |           `-- surfaces[ownerId]: SelectionSurfaceState                    
          |   |
          |   |-- getCanvasSnapshot(): CanvasDocument
          |   |   `-- root / logical-node edges / sections
          |   |-- resolveDiagram(diagramId): DiagramView
          |   |   `-- diagrams.resolve(context, diagramId)
          |   |-- exportHistory()                diagrams.exportContext(context)
          |   |-- forkHistory()                  diagrams.forkContext(context, view)
          |   |
          |   `-- nodes(): DisplayNode[]         derived public registry                  
          |       |                                                                       
          |       |-- DisplayNode = CanvasDisplayNode                                     
          |       |   |-- id                     grid:... or floating:...                 
          |       |   |-- version                document version at read time            
          |       |   |-- childIds[]                                                      
          |       |   `-- expansion              expanded | collapsed                     
          |       |                                                                       
          |       |-- Grid branch                layout: "grid"                           
          |       |   |-- kind                   diagram | group                          
          |       |   |-- boxId                  authoritative GridBox ID                 
          |       |   |-- geometry                                                        
          |       |   |   |-- units              "cells"                                  
          |       |   |   `-- bounds: GridBounds                                          
          |       |   |       `-- column / row / columns / rows                           
          |       |   `-- content?: DiagramContent                                        
          |       |                                                                       
          |       `-- Floating branch            layout: "floating"                       
          |           |-- geometry                                                        
          |           |   |-- units              "pixels"                                 
          |           |   |-- position { x, y }                                           
          |           |   |-- bounds { width, height }                                    
          |           |   `-- coordinateSpace    canvas | viewport                        
          |           |-- placement: FloatingPlacement                                    
          |           |   |-- grid-region        selected source rectangle                
          |           |   |-- parent             projection owner                         
          |           |   |-- conversation       anchor + presentation                    
          |           |   `-- stored             retained coordinate space                
          |           `-- value: FloatingBox                                              
          |               |-- SelectionRegion   kind: selection                           
          |               |-- ProjectedPane     kind: projection                          
          |               |-- ConversationPane  kind: conversation                        
          |               `-- DetailPane        kind: detail                              
          |                                                                               
          |-- useAgentCanvasBridge(...)          agent access + controller edits          
          |
          |-- checkpoint / document-metadata changes
          |   `-- 150 ms debounce -> queued workspace save(capture())
          |       `-- editing history saved; catalog publication remains explicit
          |
          `-- capture(): MappingWorkspaceSnapshot                                         
              |-- schemaVersion: 3 / projectId / activeDocumentId?                        
              `-- documents[]: MappingDocumentSnapshot                                    
                  |-- representationId          document key, possibly draft-...          
                  |-- savedRepresentationId?    saved catalog identity                    
                  |-- name / revisionId / savedName / savedScene                          
                  |-- document / canvas                                                   
                  |-- history?: CanvasHistoryRecord     controller.exportHistory()
                  `-- viewport?                                                           
                                                                                          
          DisplayNode snapshots expose both stores without duplicating geometry.          
          GridBoxes occupy grid space; FloatingBoxes never displace them.
